title: Neocloud General Compute, which specializes in bare-metal infrastructure, raised a $100M Series A led by Blackbird and Abstract at an $800M post-money valuation (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch: Neocloud General Compute, which specializes in bare-metal infrastructure, raised a $100M Series A led by Blackbird and Abstract at an $800M post-money valuation — CoreWeave, a publicly traded neocloud that rents out computing power for AI, has seen its stock price fall to a 12-month low …
